policy: UI motion curves come from shared tokens. Constant-speed temporal motion is limited to continuous loading rotation. CSS keyword parsing coordinates and authored nonlinear Hitu keyframe data retain their independent contracts; static gradients, chart geometry, instantaneous updates and direct user input are outside this policy.

keywordDefinition.reason: These coordinates parse standard CSS keyword semantics; replacing them with project token defaults would change the meaning of authored CSS. The exception is limited to this declaration, not its entire file.

authoredCurve.reason: HituFrame.cubic is a public numeric tuple for an authored outgoing keyframe segment. A sibling frame property identifies the keyframe data; valid nonlinear curves remain supported instead of being replaced by UI transition tokens.

definition.reason: Continuous loading rotation retains its existing constant-speed period.
